card.title: Samsung Galaxy a536 No Touch and Display Repair

source.title: Samsung Galaxy a536 No Touch and Display Repair

claims.statement: Galaxy A536 losing touch and/or display after drops, unchanged by new FPC and screen, has broken inner-layer traces near the front baseband/CPU shields; OL/high readings on specific display/touch pins confirm.
Fix: remove shields, scrape off the ground layer, expose the second layer and rebuild the traces with 0.007 mm wire, then UV mask.

procedure: Scrape to the second layer; jumper broken traces.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Inexperienced work here can cause a dead board or no display.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
